login.title: Sign in to the dashboard
login.body: Use your gezcez account. You'll continue on oauth.gezcez.com and come straight back here.
login.footer: Staff only. Every action is audit-logged.

errors.state_mismatch: This sign-in link is stale or was opened in another tab. Start again from the dashboard.
errors.invalid_grant: The sign-in code expired. Start again.
errors.network: Couldn't reach the gezcez API. Check your connection and try again.
errors.server: The sign-in server returned an error.

loggedOut.title: You're signed out
loggedOut.body: You've been signed out of the dashboard and of gezcez on this browser.

stepUp.done: Confirmed. You can close this window.
stepUp.failed: Confirmation didn't complete. Close this window and try again.

mock.title: Mock sign-in
mock.body: Mock mode: no real account is used. Pick a persona to see the dashboard with their permissions.
mock.unavailable: Mock sign-in only exists in mock builds.
